title: foundry/v0
description: FoundryH v0 declaration: which immutable core plus versioned packs apply to a repo. Additive-only schema: v0 readers ignore unknown keys. The 400-line review limit is immutable Gentle-AI core (RDD) and is intentionally NOT re-declared here to avoid duplication. Init v0 writes the declared contract from exactly 2 versioned answers (identical re-run or versioned diff); sync is a read-only pinned-pack comparator (harden-only overrides); baseline/v0.1 is a local-only hand-filled counter table with no token totals, no execution at root, no push.
$comment: OQ resolutions (v0 safe defaults, parked items noted in per-property descriptions): OQ-1 verification flags parked, bare commands assumed CI non-watch; OQ-2 codegraph required=fail with init hint in explore, optional=warn; OQ-3 migrationCare notes are human-only; OQ-4 token model/limits parked until baseline measured, only tokenForecastRequired boolean; OQ-5 reviewFocus[0] maps to review start --focus; OQ-6 overrides exceptionId is free-text, registry TBD; OQ-7 orgDetails optional with safe defaults; OQ-8 team mode single-writer v0 only; OQ-9 budget strategy single-pr v0 only; OQ-10 erp-dotnet-angular is one v0 reference instance, SAP/servicios out of scope and not invented.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Fixed to foundry/v0 in v0.

core.description: Immutable core harness version. Never edited per company or project in v0.

packs.description: Pinned pack versions. All packs pinned at @0.1.0 in v0.

stack.description: Stack pack reference. v0 known instances: erp-dotnet-angular@0.1.0 (one exigent reference instance, not all ERPs), lightweight-generic@0.1.0. OQ-10: SAP/servicios out of scope v0, do not invent instances.

org.description: Optional org policy pack reference. OQ-7: optional in v0; absent means org defaults apply.

team.description: Team pack reference, pinned @0.1.0 in v0.

budget.description: Budget pack reference, pinned @0.1.0 in v0. OQ-9: only single-pr strategy exists in v0.

stack.description: Free-form stack tags for routing and readability (e.g. dotnet, angular, sqlserver). OQ-10: informational only in v0, no pack resolution derives from tags.

codegraph.description: CodeGraph policy. OQ-2: required means explore fails with an init hint when no index exists; optional means warn and continue without the graph.

verification.description: Verification commands in run order. OQ-1: bare command names (e.g. ng test means CI non-watch mode); exact flags parked until CI evidence is gathered. Sync/baseline intent-not-runner guard: intents are recorded in run order and never executed at the harness root.

failFast.description: Stop at the first failing verification command when true.

reviewFocus.description: Ordered review lenses, primary-first. OQ-5: reviewFocus[0] maps to review start --focus.

migrationCare.description: Extra care for migrations. OQ-3: v0 enforcement is human-only; notes are guidance for the reviewer, not machine gates.

requireMigrationReview.description: When true, migrations require explicit human review before apply.

notes.description: Human-only migration guidance. OQ-3: not interpreted by tooling in v0.
Legacy free-text stack note, kept for foundry/v0 additive compatibility. Prefer migrationCare.notes for new migration guidance.

orgDetails.description: Org policy details. OQ-7: all optional in v0; absent means org defaults apply.

allowedLanguages.description: Languages permitted in the repo (e.g. csharp, typescript). OQ-7: optional advisory list in v0, no machine gate.

commitConvention.description: Commit message convention identifier (e.g. conventional-commits). OQ-7: advisory in v0.

artifactLanguage.description: Default language for generated artifacts. Defaults to en per the artifact language contract.

mode.description: Writer mode. OQ-8: single-writer is the only v0 mode; fixed or rotating modes are parked for v1.

strategy.description: Branching strategy. v0 only supports small-prs-to-main.

budgetDetails.description: Budget pack details. The 400-line review limit lives in immutable Gentle-AI core (RDD) and is not re-declared here. OQ-4: token model and numeric limits are parked until a baseline is measured. Baseline/v0.1 records counters-or-n/a only; token totals are forbidden.

strategy.description: Delivery strategy. OQ-9: single-pr is the only v0 strategy; auto-chain is parked for v1.

tokenForecastRequired.description: OQ-4: when true (ERP exigent default), a token forecast is required before long work; when false (lightweight default), it is skipped. Numeric token model and limits parked until baseline measured.

overrides.description: Project-level overrides. Harden-only rule: overrides may only harden defaults; loosening a default requires exceptionId. OQ-6: exceptionId is free-text in v0, registry TBD. Sync verifies pinned @0.1.0 packs and surfaces drift as diff; loosening without exceptionId fails naming the key.

exceptionId.description: Exception identifier permitting a loosening override. OQ-6: free-text in v0, registry TBD.

init.description: v0 init answers, fixed and versioned in the repo. Exactly 2 answers (stack selection + team size); re-run with unchanged answers is identical, with changed answers shows a versioned diff requiring confirmation.

versioned.description: Init result must be fixed and versioned in the repo. Always true in v0.
